extensions.hardware_basis: TZ20002MG, 60W 12V 5A DC motor, BTS7960 HW-039, Arduino Uno clone, optical/IR pulse sensor disc (4 holes/rev)
extensions.serial_protocol_status: Manual protocol active: PC sends MODE:MANUAL, SET_TARGET:<rpm>, START, and STOP. Arduino replies ACK:MODE_MANUAL, ACK:TARGET:<rpm>, ACK:START, ACK:STOP, and TARGET_REACHED:<rpm>; telemetry remains RPM:<int>;PWM:<int>;TIME:<float>;TARGET:<int>. PWM/PID and soft-ramp remain controlled by Arduino.
extensions.architecture_status: Manual RPM mode uses the dedicated arduino_manual_rpm_reader and spinning_drop_manual_watcher. The operator selects a target up to 6000 RPM; Arduino performs PID control and soft-ramp, and the watcher appends one table row when TARGET_REACHED:<rpm> is received. Manual mode does not use the Standard 1000..6000 automatic stage sequence or Standard autostop.
extensions.time_fields_status: TIME(s) displays show the firmware telemetry field TIME (seconds since the last TARGET_RPM change); the second display is a reserved duplicate.
extensions.stop_button_binding: The red STOP button is bound to the application-level Global Stop and stops the motor while terminating runtime, camera, and serial resources.
extensions.physical_validation: Manual Mode physically tested in source operation through at least 1000 and 1500 RPM; motor control, target-reached logging, capture, stop behavior, and Excel export were confirmed operational.
extensions.density_template_status: Density selector is active. Manual Δρ preserves the original direct-entry workflow. Template mode resolves Water=1000 kg/m3, Oil=850 kg/m3, or Custom manual densities, then supplies abs(density_1-density_2) to Vonnegut IFT and the measurement watcher.
extensions.manual_mode_status: Manual Mode active and validated: Target RPM is wired to the dedicated Manual RPM reader, TARGET_REACHED drives the Manual watcher/table logging, and PWM remains PID-controlled by Arduino.

extensions.use_case: Chemical EOR / petrophysics spinning-drop interfacial tension
